_about: Keyed by the Arabic name the pages show. `aliases`: other names riders use for the same place, shown under the page title so searches for either name find the page (sources: rider usage seen on 3lagnb.com and in the press, and the DT4A survey's own names, 2026-09-28). `notes`: a line that clears up a name people often mix up.

notes.مطار النزهة: ده مطار النزهة القديم جنب سموحة، مش مطار برج العرب.
